'''Mother:''' [[Carrie Savage]] |java='''Father:''' [[Yūji Ueda]] }} '''Sophocles's parents''' are recurring characters who appeared in {{aniseries|SM}}. Sophocles's father is vice-president of the [[Alola]] tourism center. ==History== ==={{aniseries|SM}}=== Sophocles's parents debuted in ''[[SM019|A Guardian Rematch!]]''. They live in a house in [[Hau'oli City]] together with their son. {{an|Sophocles}} brought {{Ash}} home with him and introduced him to them. In ''[[SM024|Alolan Open House!]]'', they visited Sophocles at the [[Pokémon School]] as part of the Visiting Day. They were seen chatting with {{Delia}}. In ''[[SM026|So Long, Sophocles!]]'', they informed Sophocles that they were moving house. Sophocles feared that this meant moving to another island when in fact they were just moving a few houses away. Sophocles's mother reappeared in ''[[SM057|The Dex Can't Help It!]]'', where she found Sophocles frozen by {{an|Rotom Pokédex}} when it took on the form of {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Rotom|Frost Rotom}}. In ''[[SM069|Rise and Shine, Starship!]]'', they were camping with Sophocles at [[Bamboo Hill]] when he encountered a {{p|Celesteela}}. They were later seen delivering Sophocles a late-night snack, only to see him engrossed in his research. Sophocles's father briefly appeared in ''[[SM081|A Young Royal Flame Ignites!]]'', where he was watching the [[Battle Royal]] along with Sophocles. Sophocles's mother appeared during a flashback in ''[[SM087|Filling the Light with Darkness!]]'', where Sophocles revealed that she had been sleeping due to the effects of a {{an|Necrozma}}. In ''[[SM093|Lillier and the Staff!]]'', they watched Sophocles perform in the school play. Sophocles's father briefly reappeared again in ''[[SM110|Keeping Your Eyes on the Ball!]]'', where he was watching Kahili play a round of PokéGolf on TV. In ''[[SM134|The Road to The Semifinals!]]'', Sophocles's parents watched their son's battle against {{an|Kiawe}} in the [[Manalo Conference]] on TV. Though Sophocles lost, his parents praised his effort and decided to have a [[malasada]] party when he returned home. ==Character== Sophocles's parents are supportive of their son, evidenced by the fact that they built a lab for Sophocles to use.
